title: The 4T Club
author: Nathan Tabor
original: • The 4T Club: Inspired by 4-H, standing for Truth, Time, Travel, and Transfiguration, represented by a four-leaf clover with a white "T" in each leaf and a left-pointing stem.
next: Build an independent 4T Club landing and member activity outline around Truth, Time, Travel and Transfiguration.
acceptance: The four-leaf mark has a white T on each leaf and its stem points left.
